kohs_anchors.screen.title: KoHs Anchor's
kohs_anchors.screen.subtitle: Anchor and glowstone, exactly as you pressed them
kohs_anchors.option.anchor_debris.descri: Block debris particles of anchor explosions. Turning them off saves frames in anchor fights; other explosions keep theirs.
kohs_anchors.option.interface_motion.des: Floating particles, entrance effects, the animated anchor and the workshop's transitions on this screen.
kohs_anchors.stats.title: This session
kohs_anchors.footer.note: Every action is your own click. The server decides.
kohs_anchors.preview.hint: Drag: turn · Wheel: zoom · Click: charge
kohs_anchors.advanced.banner.title: Not secure: bannable on most servers
kohs_anchors.advanced.banner.text: These options change when your clicks reach the server. Anticheats such as Grim flag them and many servers ban for them. Each one takes two warnings, and they only act in singleplayer, on your local network and on servers you allow.
kohs_anchors.option.hide_detonating.desc: The anchor you detonate disappears the moment you click, instead of standing there until the server's explosion arrives. Drawing only: the block, its collision and what the server sees do not change, and it reappears at once if the server keeps it.
kohs_anchors.option.fast_chain.descripti: Clicks on an exploding anchor are sent at once instead of waiting for the server to remove it, and the next anchor, its charge and its explosion are drawn at once. Glowstone that would land as a block and anchors that would stack are dropped.
kohs_anchors.option.instant_detonation.d: A click that detonates an anchor is sent the moment you press it, remapped key or mouse, instead of on the next game tick (up to 50 ms sooner). Vanilla never sends a click between ticks.
kohs_anchors.warning.title: YOU ARE WARNED
kohs_anchors.warning.subtitle: "%s" is not secure
kohs_anchors.warning.body: It changes when your clicks reach the server. Anticheats such as Grim may flag it and many servers forbid it: you could be kicked or banned. Check whether its use is allowed on the server you are playing on before you continue.
kohs_anchors.warning.activated.sub: Only where your server allows it.
kohs_anchors.footer.note.advanced: Not secure: you decide, the server rules.
kohs_anchors.option.anchor_debounce.desc: A second anchor placed with the same slot sooner than this after the last one is ignored: a double click, a bouncing switch or a held key no longer puts two anchors down. Switching slots ends the wait, and detonating is never slowed. Vanilla: no limit.
kohs_anchors.option.glowstone_debounce.d: The same for glowstone: a second charge or glowstone block with the same slot within this time is ignored, so a double click cannot charge twice or drop a glowstone block where the anchor just exploded. Vanilla: no limit.
kohs_anchors.option.core: Pressed order, fresh target, early clicks, no stacking, instant detonation effects
kohs_anchors.option.core.description: What made KoHs Anchor's land your clicks right is no longer optional: bursts land in the order you pressed them, one slot change per tick and before its clicks, as Vanilla sends them; clicks on an exploding anchor wait for the free block, double clicks never stack an anchor, and the explosion is heard and seen the moment you press.
kohs_anchors.option.herzium.description: Herzium decides which hotbar key wins in a tick; KoHs Anchor's plays anchor bursts in the order you pressed them, one slot change per tick, before its clicks. Both agree under every Herzium order, so nothing has to adapt. Click to change Herzium's order from here.
kohs_anchors.option.herzium_old.descript: This Herzium applies a key pressed after a click before that click. KoHs Anchor's still plays anchor bursts in pressed order, but update Herzium to 1.10.6 or later for everything else. Click to change Herzium's order.
kohs_anchors.option.herzium_missing.desc: Not installed. With Herzium, its hotbar order shows here and can be changed from this screen.
kohs_anchors.option.glow_enabled.descrip: Charged anchors give off light: their lit pixels shine, the light blooms around them and falls on the blocks nearby. Walls hide it; it never shows an anchor you could not see.
kohs_anchors.option.glow_source.descript: From the texture: each pixel glows in its own colour, the one your skin gives it. Custom: one colour for all of the light.
kohs_anchors.option.glow_color.descripti: The colour of the light when the glow colour is custom.
kohs_anchors.option.glow_power.descripti: How strong the whole glow is.
kohs_anchors.option.glow_bloom.descripti: The soft light around the lit pixels, shaped by them: four charge lights bloom as four.
kohs_anchors.option.glow_spill.descripti: The floor, walls and ceiling near the anchor lit in its colour, fading with distance and angle, only where the anchor can see them.
kohs_anchors.option.glow_emissive.descri: The portal, the veins and the charge lights shine at full strength even in the dark.
kohs_anchors.option.glow_pulse.descripti: The light breathes slowly, each anchor on its own beat.
More light with every charge, as the anchor's own light level does.
kohs_anchors.option.enemy_enabled.descri: Enemy anchors glow in the colour below instead of yours.
kohs_anchors.option.crystal_colors.descr: Takes the anchor's colours and glow from KoHs Crystal Tweaks: the frame, the glow, each charge light and the enemy colour, translated for a stone block, and keeps them in step.
Every anchor charge you hear plays the sound below instead of Vanilla's.
kohs_anchors.option.sound_charge_pick.de: Any sound the game knows, including a resource pack's.
kohs_anchors.option.sound_explosion_cust: Every anchor explosion you hear, yours at the click and everyone's from the server, plays the sound below.
kohs_anchors.option.sound_explosion_pick: Any sound the game knows. Other explosions keep theirs.
kohs_anchors.option.sound_preview.descri: Plays the sound as you will hear it.
kohs_anchors.option.server_lock.descript: Only in singleplayer, on your local network and on a server you allowed in this session. Anywhere else they stay switched on but do nothing, and the second warning asks you once per connection. Where you allowed them is private: nothing about it is saved, so every new session asks again.
kohs_anchors.option.dev_mode.description: For development: names become the code behind them (classes, methods, mixins), an inspector opens at the top left (F12 hides it), and the mixins are listed here.
kohs_anchors.footer.note.anchor: Changes reach every anchor in the world at once.
kohs_anchors.footer.note.reset: Press again to reset this tab.
kohs_anchors.warning.second.title: IT IS BANNABLE
kohs_anchors.warning.second.body: Players have been banned for this. "%s" will only act in singleplayer, on your local network and on servers you allow one by one: every other server asks again when you join. Only allow a server whose rules permit it.
kohs_anchors.server.title: SECOND WARNING
kohs_anchors.server.body: Not secure options are on (%s) and this server is not one you allowed, so they are suspended here. Using them on a server whose rules forbid them can get you banned. Allow them only if this server permits anchor optimizers.
kohs_anchors.workshop.unavailable: The anchor textures could not be read
kohs_anchors.workshop.hint.colors: Pick a layer on the right and a colour: the whole layer takes it and keeps its texture. Drag the anchor to turn it.
kohs_anchors.crystal.missing.title: You need KoHs Crystal Tweaks
kohs_anchors.crystal.missing.body: KoHs Crystal Tweaks sets the anchor's colours and glow automatically from your crystal colours. It is not installed and there is no crystal_tweaks.json to read. Get it on Modrinth:
kohs_anchors.crystal.result.title: Crystal colours → anchor
kohs_anchors.crystal.result.body: Frame from the outer frame, darkened to obsidian; glow and portal from the core (or the most vivid colour); the four charge lights ramp from the inner frame to the core; the light from the crystal glow; enemy anchors from the enemy crystals.
kohs_anchors.crystal.result.synced: In step with KoHs Crystal Tweaks: change your crystal colours and the anchor follows.
kohs_anchors.dev.warning.title: DEVELOPER MODE
kohs_anchors.dev.warning.subtitle: This is for development
kohs_anchors.dev.warning.body: Names and descriptions turn into the code behind them: classes, methods, mixins and the settings they write. An inspector opens at the top left: point at any part of this screen to see what it is. It changes nothing in the game.
kohs_anchors.dev.credit: Zymekoh & KoHzemyora · 2026 · Not affiliated with Mojang
kohs_anchors.dev.inspector.hint: Point at anything on this screen.
kohs_anchors.dev.anchor_debounce.descrip: MultiPlayerGameModeMixin @ useItemOn HEAD → AnchorDebounce.refuses(player, hand, hit): FAIL before any prediction or packet. Intent PLACE_ANCHOR; detonations are Intent.NONE. Window.start at RETURN; noteSelected ends it on a slot change. config anchorDebounceMillis.
kohs_anchors.dev.glowstone_debounce.desc: Same hook; Intent USE_GLOWSTONE for a charge (charge < 4) or a glowstone block; a full anchor is NONE. config glowstoneDebounceMillis.
kohs_anchors.dev.hide_detonating.descrip: RenderSectionRegionMixin @ getBlockState HEAD, SodiumLevelSliceMixin (@Pseudo, require 0) and VeiledOutlineMixin @ extractBlockOutline TAIL. Lifted by ClientLevelServerStateMixin @ setServerVerifiedBlockState, by DetonationPredictor.onAcknowledged @ handleBlockChangedAck, or after 1.5 s. config hideDetonating.
kohs_anchors.dev.core.description: replay() in pressed order at the first keyHotbarSlots read, one stretch per tick: after a click (tickSlot, set by MultiPlayerGameModeMixin), a slot change and the presses after it wait in Vanilla's counters (MinecraftMixin @ consumeClick) for the next tick. hold()/releaseHeld() for detonating anchors, mergesRepeat(), showAtInput() from KeyMappingMixin @ click TAIL. The core flags are transient: not saved.
kohs_anchors.dev.herzium_old.description: Reflection on dev.zymekoh.herzium.config.HerziumConfig.get().hotbarOrder() / cycleHotbarOrder(). Version below 1.10.6: its pass applies a key pressed after a click.
kohs_anchors.dev.herzium.description: Reflection on dev.zymekoh.herzium.config.HerziumConfig.get().hotbarOrder() / cycleHotbarOrder(). No runtime adaptation: KoHs consumes an anchor burst before Herzium's pass.
kohs_anchors.dev.interface_motion.descri: AnchorsUi.sigil/motes/comets/slash, AnchorWorkshop entrance, warnings' motion; time-based, System.nanoTime().
kohs_anchors.dev.glow_enabled.descriptio: LevelRendererGlowMixin @ submitBlockEntities TAIL → SubmitNodeCollector.submitCustomGeometry(GlowMaterial.glow()). AnchorTracker: server states, own placements, palette scan every 10 ticks. config glow.enabled.
kohs_anchors.dev.glow_source.description: SOURCE_TEXTURE: GlowGeometry runs keep each pixel's composed colour, spill uses SkinComposer.averageGlowColor. SOURCE_CUSTOM: Glow.color scaled by the pixel's luminance.
kohs_anchors.dev.glow_power.description: intensity = power/100 × (0.4 + 0.6 charge/4) × pulse × distance fade 48-64 blocks.
kohs_anchors.dev.glow_bloom.description: 8×8 cells + 2 border, Gaussian σ = 1.15 cells, normalised per face, faded below the base.
kohs_anchors.dev.glow_spill.description: Exposed faces of solid blocks within 3, facing the anchor, sampled line of sight; Lambert × 1/(1 + 0.55 d²), quartered faces, rebuilt every 0.4 s.
kohs_anchors.dev.glow_emissive.descripti: Lit pixels merged into rows, drawn 0.0025 off the face.
kohs_anchors.dev.crystal_colors.descript: read() ← config/crystal_tweaks.json (visuals, glow, enemyVisuals); map() in OKLab: frame L 0.23, glow L 0.66, charge ramp L 0.62→0.86; apply() → Skin + Glow + EnemyGlow; syncIfChanged() on file time.
kohs_anchors.dev.sound_charge_custom.des: ClientPacketListenerMixin @ handleSoundEvent → @WrapOperation ClientLevel.playSeededSound, holder swapped when it is block.respawn_anchor.charge.
handleExplosion playLocalSound @WrapOperation for anchor explosions; DetonationPredictor.detonate → AnchorSounds.playExplosion.
kohs_anchors.dev.sound_explosion_pick.de: Any SOUND_EVENT key; resource pack sounds work too.
kohs_anchors.dev.fast_chain.description: AnchorInput.decide → RUN / RUN_PREDICTED / CATCH_UP / DROP; predictions drawn by AnchorVeil. Two warnings; acts only where ServerLock.allowedHere().
kohs_anchors.dev.instant_detonation.desc: KeyMappingMixin @ click TAIL: keyUse.consumeClick() → startUseItem between client ticks. Two warnings; acts only where ServerLock.allowedHere().
kohs_anchors.dev.server_lock.description: local = no ServerData, ServerData.isLan(), or a loopback/site-local literal address; allowed = Settings.allowedServers. tick() opens ServerWarningScreen once per connection.
kohs_anchors.dev.dev_mode.description: DevInspector.node() per drawn element, render() at the end of the frame; F12 toggles the panel.
kohs_anchors.enemy.subtitle: Enemy anchors: the ones other players placed
kohs_anchors.option.enemy_about.descript: An anchor is an enemy's when it appears where you placed none. Anchors that were there before you arrived glow like yours.
kohs_anchors.dev.enemy_about.description: A server state that turns a non-anchor into an anchor with no own placement there in the last 4 s. The header switch sets AnchorsScreen.enemyPage.
kohs_anchors.option.glowstone_guard.desc: In an anchor fight glowstone only charges anchors: a click that would put it down as a block is dropped, as if it had not been pressed. It rules out the safe anchor, which puts glowstone down on purpose: made for spamming. Only acts within 4 s of your last anchor action.
kohs_anchors.option.anchor_smoke.descrip: The smoke cloud of anchor explosions, which hides the other player in a chain: Vanilla, Light (one small puff) or None. Sound, flash and knockback are unchanged, and other explosions keep their smoke. Less smoke also means fewer particles to draw.
kohs_anchors.option.glow_quality.descrip: How much of the glow each anchor gets. Performance: coarser light, and bounce light for the 3 nearest anchors only. Balanced: full detail up close. Quality: full detail farther out. Anchors out of view and faces turned away are never drawn.
kohs_anchors.dev.glowstone_guard.descrip: useItemOn HEAD: glowstone whose use would place a block (not an anchor, or sneaking) within 4 s of an anchor action returns FAIL. Settings.glowstoneGuard.
kohs_anchors.dev.anchor_smoke.descriptio: handleExplosion addParticle (anchor explosions only, DetonationPredictor.isAnchorExplosion) and the predicted detonation: EXPLOSION_EMITTER, one EXPLOSION, or nothing. Settings.anchorSmoke.
kohs_anchors.dev.glow_quality.descriptio: LOD distances {4,12,24} / {8,20,36} / {16,32,48}, bounce light for the nearest 3 / 8 / 16 within 10 / 16 / 24 blocks, vertex budget 40k / 90k / 200k. View cone and back faces always culled.
kohs_anchors.glowstone_warning.title: Before you turn it on
kohs_anchors.glowstone_warning.body: If you turn this on you can't safe anchor. It's meant for spamming. You've been warned.
kohs_anchors.glowstone_warning.no_video: The clip could not be played.
